title: Structural basis of the AlgU-MucA(cyto) interaction and SspB-mediated degradation in Pseudomonas aeruginosa stress response.
authors: Li, Tao; Wang, Yingzhi; Zhao, Ninglin; Ge, Chunlei; Wu, Cuiling; Li, Ke; Li, Li; Wang, Zhiqiang; Chen, Ying; Chen, Zhenpu; Li, Weike; Liu, Yang; Wang, Zhonghui; Sha, Yun; Yao, Hong; Zhu, Yibo; Bao, Rui
one_liner_zh: 该文解析了铜绿假单胞菌应激调控中AlgU-MucA(cyto)复合物的晶体结构及SspB介导的降解机制，属于蛋白-蛋白互作体系，虽涉及转录因子AlgU但非TF-DNA结合，且方法以结构生物学和AlphaFold3建模为主，与TF-DNA互作课题关联有限。
abstract: In Pseudomonas aeruginosa, the sigma factor AlgU functions as a critical stress-responsive regulator governing essential physiological processes. This study assessed algU-dependent phenotypes through targeted gene knockout, including effects on alginate secretion and host cell invasion. Furthermore, an innovative fusion protein strategy addressed complex preparation challenges, enabling the determination of a high-resolution (2.101 A) structure of the AlgU-MucA(cyto) complex and revealing an exceptionally low backbone deviation of merely 0.01 A relative to the reported 6IN7 complex. Structural analysis revealed an extensive mutation-resistant interaction network at the binding interface, stabilized primarily by salt bridges, hydrogen bonds, and hydrophobic interactions. Subsequent mutational validation confirmed that triple or sextuple alanine substitutions at critical interaction sites maintained complex binding integrity while significantly compromising thermal stability, indicating that although dispensable for binding, these residues are indispensable for complex stability. Crucially, pull-down assays identified SspB as the essential adaptor bridging the AlgU-MucA(cyto) complex to the ClpX/ClpP protease; AlphaFold3 modeling and quantitative BLI measurements reveal that SspB engages AlgU via its N-terminal domain and binds ClpX through its disordered C-terminus, enabling substrate delivery and proteolysis-coupled AlgU release. Collectively, these findings elucidate a dual-safeguard regulatory mechanism: inherent mutation resistance at the binding interface prevents aberrant AlgU activation by common clinical mucA mutations, while SspB-mediated proteolysis ensures stimulus-responsive AlgU liberation. This evolutionary adaptation confers resistance against detrimental AlgU overactivation in P. aeruginosa and provides novel therapeutic targets. IMPORTANCE: Deletion of the algU gene affected the production of pyoverdine, pyocyanin, and alginate in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, as well as its cell invasiveness. By fusing AlgU and MucA(cyto), we were able to obtain an AlgU-MucA(cyto) protein complex with both high yield and purity, and successfully obtained a crystal structure of the AlgU-MucA(cyto) complex. Structural analysis revealed an extensive and robust network of salt bridges, hydrogen bonds, and charge interactions between the two proteins. Multi-site alanine substitutions (up to sextuple mutations) in interfacial charged clusters of the AlgU-MucA(cyto) complex fail to disrupt binding but severely impair thermal stability, revealing that these residues are binding-redundant yet stability-essential. Structural modeling and BLI measurements identify SspB as a dual-interface adaptor: its N-terminal domain recognizes the preassembled AlgU-MucA(cyto) complex (via the AlgU hairpin surface), whereas its flexible C-terminal tail engages ClpX, thereby bridging AlgU-MucA(cyto) to ClpXP and positioning MucA(cyto) for proteolysis-coupled AlgU release.
abstract_zh: 在铜绿假单胞菌（*Pseudomonas aeruginosa*）中，sigma因子AlgU作为关键的应激响应调节因子，调控着重要的生理过程。本研究通过靶向基因敲除评估了依赖algU的表型，包括对藻酸盐分泌和宿主细胞侵袭的影响。此外，一种创新的融合蛋白策略解决了复杂的制备难题，使得能够测定AlgU-MucA(cyto)复合物的高分辨率（2.101 Å）结构，并揭示其相对于已报道的6IN7复合物仅0.01 Å的极低主链偏差。结构分析显示，结合界面存在一个广泛的抗突变相互作用网络，主要由盐桥、氢键和疏水相互作用稳定。随后的突变验证证实，在关键相互作用位点进行三重或六重丙氨酸替换保持了复合物结合完整性，但显著损害了热稳定性，表明这些残基虽对结合非必需，但对复合物稳定性不可或缺。关键的是，pull-down实验鉴定出SspB是连接AlgU-MucA(cyto)复合物与ClpX/ClpP蛋白酶的关键衔接蛋白；AlphaFold3建模和定量BLI测量揭示，SspB通过其N端结构域结合AlgU，并通过其无序的C端尾部结合ClpX，从而实现底物递送和偶联蛋白水解的AlgU释放。综合来看，这些发现阐明了一种双重保护调控机制：结合界面固有的抗突变性防止了常见临床mucA突变引起的异常AlgU激活，而SspB介导的蛋白水解确保了刺激响应性的AlgU释放。这种进化适应赋予铜绿假单胞菌抵抗有害AlgU过度激活的能力，并提供了新的治疗靶点。重要性：algU基因的缺失影响了铜绿假单胞菌中pyoverdine、pyocyanin和藻酸盐的产生，以及其细胞侵袭性。通过融合AlgU和MucA(cyto)，我们能够获得高产率和高纯度的AlgU-MucA(cyto)蛋白复合物，并成功获得了AlgU-MucA(cyto)复合物的晶体结构。结构分析揭示了两蛋白之间存在广泛且稳健的盐桥、氢键和电荷相互作用网络。在AlgU-MucA(cyto)复合物界面电荷簇中的多位点丙氨酸替换（多达六重突变）未能破坏结合，但严重损害了热稳定性，表明这些残基对结合冗余但对稳定性至关重要。结构建模和BLI测量将SspB鉴定为双界面衔接蛋白：其N端结构域识别预组装的AlgU-MucA(cyto)复合物（通过AlgU发夹表面），而其柔性C端尾部结合ClpX，从而将AlgU-MucA(cyto)桥接至ClpXP，并定位MucA(cyto)以进行偶联蛋白水解的AlgU释放。
